sections.heading: Company profile
sections.body:
Asset Liquidity sells, buys, and leases used printing, bindery, packaging, and paper converting equipment, sourcing repossessed and end-of-lease machinery from banks and financial institutions.

Industry: Equipment Sales & Services · HQ: Ontario, California · Size: not published · Products: Printing Equipment, Bindery Equipment, Offset Presses, Digital Offset Presses, Flexographic Presses, Paper Folders and Inserters

sections.heading: Qualification summary
sections.body: Asset Liquidity scores 0 of 100 (tier disqualified) at 0% confidence. Nothing was found for industry fit, application fit, company size, event engagement and pain-point alignment, so those score zero rather than being estimated.

sections.heading: Tedlar angle
sections.body: No durability claims were found in their public copy, so the opening has to establish the problem before the product. Lead with the cost of premature graphic failure rather than with film chemistry.

sections.heading: Comparable accounts
sections.body: Closest known-good accounts: Mactac (13% similar on printing, digital, paper, packaging); Drytac (10% similar on laminating, printing, polar, wide); ORAFOL Europe (8% similar on printing, digital, wide, industrial). Reference the comparable account by name on the call — a converter is far more persuaded by what a peer does than by a spec sheet.

sections.heading: Who to talk to
sections.body: No decision-maker resolved from public sources. Target titles for this ICP: VP Product, VP Product Development, VP Innovation, VP Research and Development, Director of R&D.

sections.heading: Gaps and risks
sections.body:
• Industry fit: 3 more core category terms in its positioning would reach the ceiling.
• Application fit: 4 more application area(s) would reach the ceiling.
• Company size: Any published revenue or headcount would unlock up to 15 points.
• Event engagement: Confirming attendance at one more show would add points.
• Pain-point alignment: Each additional durability theme found adds 5 points.
• Flags on the record: size unknown
